name: Imouto Kairaku Ochi ~Onii-chan ni Muriyari Hamerarete kara~
original_name: 妹快楽堕ち～お兄ちゃんに無理やりハメられてから～
source:
One day, a big brother who blindly loves his little sister 
eavesdrops what she talks on the phone.

She talks about future plans with a man and he hears that 
they say something like "If we go to the same school...".

When it is implied that she has a boyfriend, he thinks in such a way,
in despair, that the boyfriend must have bad influences over her so 
he confines her in the house in an attempt to isolate her from the guy.

Exploiting the situation where he and she are left alone in the house
during the summer vacation, he starts disciplining her to reforge their siblinghood.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE234435.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某天，极度溺爱妹妹的哥哥偷听她打电话。她谈起与一名男性的未来计划，他听见对方说了类似“如果我们上同一所学校……”的话。

听出妹妹似乎有了男朋友后，他绝望地认定这个男朋友一定会对她产生坏影响，于是把妹妹关在家里，试图将她与那个男人隔绝。

暑假期间，两人被留在家中，哥哥利用这个机会开始“管教”妹妹，试图重新塑造他们的兄妹关系。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE234435.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
